name: Simple Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Thran Khorman calls young dwarven warriors to Anvilmar. The Simple Rune is an inscribed stone token that directs recruits to seek instruction from their warrior trainer.

sections.title: A Summons to Arms
sections.body: The Simple Rune marks the start of a recruit’s training. Thran Khorman gives the inscribed stone to promising young fighters who have begun clearing threats from Coldridge Valley. Its marks are a formal summons, not a magical charm. A recruit who reads it is expected to report to Thran inside Anvilmar, where the warrior trainer teaches basic combat and offers practical advice for surviving Dun Morogh’s hostile wilds.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: The Simple Rune directs a recruit to seek formal instruction from Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar. Young warriors in Coldridge Valley receive it as an instructional tablet.
Thran Khorman sends the Simple Rune. The dwarf warrior trainer inside Anvilmar watches for promising fighters helping around the valley.

faq.q: Where do I take the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: Take the Simple Rune to Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar, in central Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a dwarven warrior, the Simple Rune marks your first step into formal training under veteran instructor Thran Khorman.
As a dwarf, Thran Khorman’s rune offers you the basics of the fight: an axe’s grip, armor’s weight, and the sweat of real battle.
